upload_file_to_repo: upload a single file to a Hugging Face Hub repo with implicit path resolution
upload_directory_with_filters: upload a directory to a Hugging Face Hub repo with include and exclude glob patterns
schedule_recurring_commits: schedule recurring commits to a Hugging Face Hub repo every N minutes
upload_private_dataset: upload a private dataset to a Hugging Face Hub repo with explicit repo type
sync_space_with_delete: sync a local Space directory with the Hub, deleting removed files via delete patterns
